what: A small photo window (40%×40%) at the center of a screen-pinned stage expands to fill the screen while scrolling through the empty space below (180lvh), and the photo inside shrinks from 1.5x to its own size, looking like a zoom-out (scrub 1, no curve). Adding a shade makes it fall from 0 → 1 over the same range — the recruit band uses an 83%×81% window · 57% shade

options.zoom: Starting scale of photo inside window, default 1.5
options.start · end: ScrollTrigger range, default top top · bottom bottom (while the stage is pinned)
options.--fx-w · --fx-h: Initial window size, default 40% · 40% (original phone is calc(100% − 10rem) · 50%)
options.--fx-travel: Distance to scroll while unfolding, default 180lvh
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Stage that sticks to the screen (sticky)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo inside the window (img · video · placeholder)
options.[data-fx-part=shade]: (if present) A veil that darkens along with it — the title above it is shown by the caller at the end
options.look: With clip, the window size isn’t changed, a full-size window is cut with clip-path inset and opened on all four sides — the photo size inside the window stays the same (Brand: 60lvh × 80lvh window · 1.2x · scrub true · 400lvh panel)

from.where: index.html photo window that unfolds after the hero (.intro — 40%×40% · 1.5→1) and recruit band (.recruit — 83%×81% · 57% veil · --fx-shade)

index.js .sl-fv (Hero — 400lvh panel, pinned window inset(10lvh, 50%−30lvh) → 0, inner photo 1.2 → 1, tied directly to scroll with no curve) · .sl-eyecatch (sky photo band — same window starting 10lvh after the top of the panel). Phone: window 25.6rem × 34rem, panel 200lvh
from.options: look: clip; zoom: 1.2; scrub: true · style="--fx-w: 60lvh; --fx-h: 80lvh; --fx-travel: 300lvh"
